title: Resilience & Hope
intro: Every child meets the thing they cannot do, the friend who moves away, the day that goes wrong from the start. This month is not about pretending those are small. It is about teaching them what to do next — that starting again is normal, that hard is not the same as forever, and that hope is a reasonable thing to hold.

keyScriptures.text: For though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.
May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.

weeks.title: Falling Down Is Not Failing
weeks.declaration: Everyone falls down. What makes someone strong is not never falling — it is that they get up, and they get up again after that.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, teach our child that falling is part of learning. Take the shame out of it for them. Amen.

weeks.title: Hard Is Not Forever
weeks.declaration: A hard day is a hard day. It is not a hard life, and it is not a verdict on you. Most hard things pass.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, give our child perspective when today feels enormous. Remind them that this will not always be now. Amen.

weeks.title: Try It Again
weeks.declaration: The thing you cannot do yet has the word 'yet' in it. Almost everything you are good at was once impossible.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, give our child patience with themselves. Let them keep going long enough to get good. Amen.

weeks.title: Hope Is Reasonable
weeks.declaration: Hoping is not naive. It is what people do who know that God is not finished with the story.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, keep hope alive in our child. Let them expect good things without being afraid to. Amen.

days.title: Everyone Falls Down
days.declaration: Everyone falls down. The difference is what happens next, and next is always available.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: The Word Yet
days.declaration: You cannot do it yet. Yet is a very important word and it changes the whole sentence.

scripture.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Hard Is Not Forever
days.declaration: This is a hard day. It is not a hard life, and today is not the shape of everything.

scripture.text: Our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory.

days.title: Starting Again
days.declaration: Starting again is not going backwards. It is the normal way people get anywhere.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

days.title: Mistakes Teach
days.declaration: A mistake you learn from has done its job. You do not have to be ashamed of it as well.

scripture.text: In all things God works for the good of those who love him.

days.title: Practice Feels Bad First
days.declaration: Everything feels bad while you are learning it. That is what learning feels like from the inside.

scripture.text: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful.

days.title: You Are Not the Only One
days.declaration: Whatever you are finding hard, you are not the only one. It just looks that way from inside.

scripture.text: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind.

days.title: Tell Someone
days.declaration: Hard things get smaller when you say them out loud to someone who loves you.

scripture.text: Carry each other's burdens.

days.title: Crying Is Allowed
days.declaration: Crying is not weakness. It is what a person does when something matters and it hurt.

scripture.text: Jesus wept.

days.title: God Is Near the Sad
days.declaration: God does not stand back when you are sad. He comes closer.

scripture.text: The Lord is close to the broken-hearted.

days.title: Losing Is Survivable
days.declaration: Losing is not the end of anything. You can lose and be completely fine.

scripture.text: I have learned the secret of being content in any and every situation.

days.title: Small Steps Count
days.declaration: On a hard day, a small step is a real step. You do not have to do it all today.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Being Left Out
days.declaration: Being left out hurts. It is not evidence that something is wrong with you.

scripture.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

days.title: It Will Not Always Be Now
days.declaration: Whatever is heavy right now, it will not always be now. Seasons genuinely change.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity.

days.title: Rest and Restart
days.declaration: Sometimes the right answer is to stop, rest and try again tomorrow. That is not quitting.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

days.title: Hope Is Not Pretending
days.declaration: Hope does not pretend the hard thing is not hard. It just refuses to believe it is the last word.

scripture.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.

days.title: Strong in the Broken Places
days.declaration: People are often kindest and strongest in the exact place they were once hurt.

scripture.text: So that we can comfort those in any trouble.

days.title: Do Not Give Up on Yourself
days.declaration: On the days you disappoint yourself, do not walk away from yourself. Stay.

scripture.text: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Put your hope in God.

days.title: Someone Is Holding On
days.declaration: When you cannot hold on, someone is holding on to you. You are not the only thing keeping you here.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand.

days.title: Ask for Help Early
days.declaration: Asking for help early makes the problem smaller. Waiting makes it bigger.

scripture.text: If either of them falls down, one can help the other up.

days.title: Not Everything Is Fixable Today
days.declaration: Some things take time to mend. Waiting well is part of being strong.

scripture.text: Wait for the Lord; be strong and take heart.

days.title: Your Best Is Enough
days.declaration: Your best on a hard day is not the same as your best on a good day. Both count.

scripture.text: The gift is acceptable according to what one has.

days.title: Changing Your Mind
days.declaration: Stopping something that is wrong for you is not failing. It is paying attention.

scripture.text: The prudent give thought to their steps.

days.title: Kindness to Yourself
days.declaration: Talk to yourself the way you would talk to a friend having the same day.

scripture.text: Love your neighbour as yourself.

days.title: The Middle Is Hard
days.declaration: Most stories are worst in the middle. You may simply be in the middle.

scripture.text: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good.

days.title: You Have Survived Every Hard Day So Far
days.declaration: Look at your record. You have got through every difficult day you have ever had.

scripture.text: The righteous person may have many troubles, but the Lord delivers him from them all.

days.title: Try a Different Way
days.declaration: If one way is not working, try another. Being stuck is often just a sign to change the route.

scripture.text: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it?

days.title: Good Comes Back
days.declaration: Good things come round again. This is not the last good thing that will ever happen to you.

scripture.text: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

days.title: Made Stronger
days.declaration: The hard things you get through do not just hurt. They also make you someone who can handle more.

scripture.text: The testing of your faith produces perseverance.

days.title: Hope Anchored
days.declaration: Hope is not wishful thinking. It is anchored to someone who does not change.

scripture.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

days.title: Keep the Proof
days.declaration: Everything you have got through this month is proof for the next hard thing. Keep the proof.

scripture.text: Perseverance produces character; and character, hope.
